conf.description: Forcepoint Web Security web-transaction LEEF feed: header-only parse (LEEF:1.0|vendor|product|version|eventId|); extension attribute names are unpublished so the tab-delimited body is retained raw under forcepoint.web.leef_extension (documented gap) rather than guessed.

conf.comment: Forcepoint Web Security, web-transaction dataset, syslog-leef format. GAP: the on-prem SIEM reference does not publish the LEEF attribute names for this predefined string (work order fields[] is empty), so only the LEEF:1.0 header is structurally parsed. The tab-delimited extension body is kept intact under a custom field pending a live sample; no ECS field-level mapping, disposition/category lookups, or _time derivation are attempted here - see README.

functions.description: identify pipeline and document the unmapped-field gap
Split the LEEF:1.0 header from the tab-delimited attribute body
Tag event.dataset/observer.version from the header; keep the unparsed extension body under a custom field pending attribute names
Drop _raw, consistent with the sibling CEF/KV web-transaction pipelines on this same high-volume feed
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
